pinyin: bīng dòng sān chǐ, fēi yī rì zhī hán
literal: ice · freeze · three · feet, not · one · day · 's · cold
natural: Rome wasn't built in a day

meaning.en: A deep problem, or a great achievement, is the result of long accumulation, not a single day.
meaning.zh: 比喻事情的形成不是一朝一夕的，有长期积累的过程。

equivalents: Rome wasn't built in a day
a long time in the making

examples.zh: 冰冻三尺，非一日之寒，这个问题已经积累多年了。
examples.en: Ice three feet thick is not the work of one cold day; this problem has built up over years.

examples.zh: 冰冻三尺非一日之寒，他的好成绩来自长期的努力。
examples.en: Good results like his come from long effort, not a single day.

examples.zh: 公司的危机是冰冻三尺，不是一朝一夕造成的。
examples.en: The firm's crisis has been a long time in the making.

usage.en: Used for both problems and achievements; often a comment on causes.
usage.zh: 可指问题，也可指成就；常用来分析原因。

story.en: Wang Chong's Lunheng argues that great things build up slowly: 'the river freezes solid not by one day's cold; a mountain rises from piled earth, not in a moment'. The idiom is the later proverbial form of this image.
story.zh: 王充《论衡·状留》：“故夫河冰结合，非一日之寒；积土成山，非斯须之作也。”后世演变为“冰冻三尺，非一日之寒”。

pinyin: jǐ suǒ bù yù, wù shī yú rén
literal: self · what · not · want, do not · inflict · on · others
natural: do as you would be done by

meaning.en: Do not do to others what you would not want done to yourself.
meaning.zh: 自己不愿意要的，不要强加给别人。

equivalents: do unto others as you would have them do unto you

examples.zh: 己所不欲，勿施于人，别把你不愿做的事推给同事。
examples.en: Don't do to others what you wouldn't want done to you; don't pass your unwanted jobs to colleagues.

examples.zh: 父母常教育孩子要己所不欲勿施于人。
examples.en: Parents often teach children not to do to others what they would not want themselves.

examples.zh: 待人接物，要记住己所不欲。
examples.en: In dealing with people, remember what you yourself would not want.

story.en: Zigong asked if there was one word to practise all life long; Confucius answered 'reciprocity: what you do not want for yourself, do not impose on others' (己所不欲，勿施于人).
story.zh: 子贡问：“有一言而可以终身行之者乎？”子曰：“其恕乎！己所不欲，勿施于人。”

usage.en: A moral maxim, often quoted in full.
usage.zh: 道德格言，多完整引用。

pinyin: yī bō wèi píng, yī bō yòu qǐ
literal: one · wave · not yet · calm, one · wave · again · rise

meaning.en: Before one trouble is settled, another arises.
meaning.zh: 一个波浪还没平息，另一个波浪又掀起来了。比喻事情接连发生，问题不断。

equivalents: no sooner has one wave subsided than another rises

examples.zh: 一波未平，一波又起，团队刚解决了资金问题，又出现了人事纠纷。
examples.en: One wave is no sooner calm than another rises: the team had just solved its funding problem when a personnel dispute broke out.

examples.zh: 这几年他家一波未平一波又起，没有一天清静。
examples.en: Over these years trouble has followed trouble in his family, with not a quiet day.

examples.zh: 疫情还没结束，又遇上经济下滑，真是一波未平。
examples.en: The epidemic wasn't over before the downturn hit.

usage.en: Predicate or comment on a run of troubles.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，评论接连发生的麻烦。

pinyin: rén zhě jiàn rén, zhì zhě jiàn zhì
literal: benevolent · one · sees · benevolence, wise · one · sees · wisdom

meaning.en: Different people hold different views on the same matter.
meaning.zh: 对同一个问题，不同的人有不同的见解。

equivalents: beauty is in the eye of the beholder

examples.zh: 这部电影仁者见仁，智者见智，评价很不一致。
examples.en: Opinions on this film differ widely; each viewer sees something different.

examples.zh: 对这项政策，仁者见仁智者见智，不必强求一致。
examples.en: Views on this policy vary, and there's no need to force agreement.

examples.zh: 这个问题仁者见仁，大家各抒己见。
examples.en: On this question everyone sees it their own way and gives their opinion.

usage.en: Often a neutral way of saying a matter is disputed.
usage.zh: 常用来表示意见分歧、各有看法。

story.en: The Commentary on the Appended Phrases says of the Way: 'the benevolent see it and call it benevolence; the wise see it and call it wisdom' (仁者见之谓之仁，知者见之谓之知). The idiom condenses it.
story.zh: 《周易·系辞上》：“仁者见之谓之仁，知者见之谓之知。”成语由此概括而来。

text: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐
pinyin: xiān tiān xià zhī yōu ér yōu, hòu tiān xià zhī lè ér lè
literal: before · world · 's · worry · and · worry, after · world · 's · joy · and · rejoice

meaning.en: To be the first to worry about the country's troubles and the last to enjoy its pleasures.
meaning.zh: 在天下人忧愁之前先忧愁，在天下人享乐之后才享乐，形容以天下为己任的胸怀。

equivalents: put the people's concerns before one's own comfort
be first to bear the burden, last to enjoy the reward

examples.zh: 他先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐，是百姓敬重的好官。
examples.en: He worried before the people did and enjoyed only after them, a good official who earned respect.

examples.zh: 好干部应当先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。
examples.en: A good cadre should bear the worries first and enjoy the benefits last.

examples.zh: 她以后天下之乐而乐的精神带领团队。
examples.en: She leads the team in a spirit of enjoying only after others have.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan's essay on Yueyang Tower says a worthy man 'worries before the world worries and rejoices after the world rejoices' (先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐).
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》：“居庙堂之高则忧其民，处江湖之远则忧其君……其必曰：先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐欤！”

usage.en: Praise for public-minded officials; formal or rhetorical.
usage.zh: 多用来称赞胸怀天下的人，书面语。

pinyin: dào gāo yī chǐ, mó gāo yī zhàng
literal: virtue · tall · one · foot, demon · tall · one · ten-foot
natural: each countermeasure meets a stronger evil

meaning.en: As good grows stronger, evil grows stronger still; the fight never ends.
meaning.zh: 正义的力量每提高一分，邪恶的力量就提高得更多。多指斗争中对方的反制手段更强。

equivalents: a game of cat and mouse
an arms race between good and evil

examples.zh: 反诈骗宣传不断加强，可道高一尺，魔高一丈，骗术也在翻新。
examples.en: Anti-fraud publicity keeps improving, but as the saying goes, the devil rises a notch higher: scams keep changing too.

examples.zh: 黑客与安全专家之间，总是道高一尺魔高一丈。
examples.en: Between hackers and security experts, each side's advance is met by the other's.

examples.zh: 魔高一丈，道高一尺，我们要不断升级防御。
examples.en: If evil rises a notch, good must too, so we must keep upgrading defences.

usage.en: Commonly cited about security, crime and enforcement; also used the other way round.
usage.zh: 常用于安全、打击犯罪等场合；也可说“魔高一丈，道高一尺”。

pinyin: tóu tòng yī tóu, jiǎo tòng yī jiǎo
literal: head · hurt · treat · head, foot · hurt · treat · foot
natural: treat the symptom, not the cause

meaning.en: To deal only with the visible symptoms, not the root cause.
meaning.zh: 哪里有病就治哪里，比喻只处理表面问题，不解决根本问题。

equivalents: treat the symptoms, not the disease

examples.zh: 治理环境不能头痛医头，脚痛医脚，要从根源上解决。
examples.en: Tackling pollution can't mean treating each symptom as it appears; the root cause must be addressed.

examples.zh: 他处理问题总是头痛医头脚痛医脚，缺乏全局观。
examples.en: He always handles problems piecemeal, lacking an overall view.

examples.zh: 这种头痛医头的办法治标不治本。
examples.en: This treat-the-symptom approach does not cure the cause.

usage.en: Criticism of short-sighted fixes; often with 不能/不要.
usage.zh: 批评只顾眼前的办法，常与“不能、不要”连用。

pinyin: má què suī xiǎo, wǔ zàng jù quán
literal: sparrow · although · small, five · organs · all · complete

meaning.en: Though small, it has every essential part.
meaning.zh: 麻雀虽然小，内脏却齐全。比喻事物虽小，各种应有的东西都具备。

examples.zh: 这家小店麻雀虽小，五脏俱全，什么日用品都有。
examples.en: The little shop is small but has everything, stocking every daily necessity.

examples.zh: 我们的公司麻雀虽小五脏俱全。
examples.en: Our company is small but has every function.

examples.zh: 这个小公园麻雀虽小，设施一应俱全。
examples.en: This little park is small yet fully equipped.

usage.en: Usually describes small organisations or places; casual and positive.
usage.zh: 多形容小机构、小场所，口语，含褒义。

pinyin: bǎi chǐ gān tóu, gèng jìn yī bù
literal: hundred · foot · pole · top, even · advance · one · step

meaning.en: Having reached a high level, still push on to improve further.
meaning.zh: 在已有很高成就的基础上继续努力，取得更大进步。

examples.zh: 成绩已经很好，但他仍希望百尺竿头，更进一步。
examples.en: His results are already good, but he hopes to climb a step higher still.

examples.zh: 愿你在新的一年里百尺竿头更进一步。
examples.en: May you go from strength to strength in the new year.

examples.zh: 取得成就后不能满足，要百尺竿头，更进一步。
examples.en: After success don't be content; push even further.

story.en: The Chan master Changsha Jingcen is recorded as saying 'on top of a hundred-foot pole, you must still take a step forward' (百尺竿头须进步), urging monks to go beyond what they have attained.
story.zh: 《景德传灯录》载长沙景岑禅师语：“百尺竿头须进步，十方世界是全身。”

usage.en: Used as encouragement or a wish; often in greetings.
usage.zh: 常用作勉励或祝愿。

pinyin: qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
literal: thousand · li · 's · journey, begins · at · foot · under
natural: a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step

meaning.en: Even the longest journey begins with the first step.
meaning.zh: 再远的路也要从脚下第一步开始走，比喻大事要从小事做起。

equivalents: a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step

examples.zh: 千里之行，始于足下，别想一口吃成胖子。
examples.en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step; don't expect to do it all at once.

examples.zh: 学外语要千里之行始于足下，每天坚持。
examples.en: Learning a language begins at your feet; keep at it every day.

examples.zh: 千里之行，始于足下，先从最简单的做起。
examples.en: Every long journey starts underfoot, so begin with the simplest part.

story.en: Laozi ch. 64: 'A tree as thick as an embrace grows from a tiny shoot; a nine-storey tower rises from a heap of earth; a journey of a thousand li begins beneath the feet.'
story.zh: 《老子》第六十四章：“合抱之木，生于毫末；九层之台，起于累土；千里之行，始于足下。”

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: Encouragement to start; often quoted whole.
usage.zh: 勉励人起步，常完整引用。

pinyin: qiān lǐ zhī dī, kuì yú yǐ xué
literal: thousand · li · 's · dyke, collapse · at · ant · nest

meaning.en: A small flaw, left unattended, can bring down something great.
meaning.zh: 千里长堤，会因小小的蚂蚁洞而崩溃。比喻小的隐患可能酿成大祸。

equivalents: a small leak can sink a great ship
a stitch in time saves nine

examples.zh: 千里之堤，溃于蚁穴，小小的违规也不能放过。
examples.en: Even small violations must not be overlooked; a long dyke can fail from an ant hole.

examples.zh: 安全工作要防微杜渐，千里之堤溃于蚁穴。
examples.en: Safety work must nip trouble in the bud, since a great dyke is breached by an ant's nest.

examples.zh: 别小看这点疏忽，千里之堤，溃于蚁穴。
examples.en: Don't underestimate this oversight; ant holes breach long dykes.

story.en: Han Feizi: 'A dyke of a thousand zhang collapses through the holes of mole crickets and ants' (千丈之堤，以蝼蚁之穴溃).
story.zh: 《韩非子·喻老》：“千丈之堤，以蝼蚁之穴溃；百尺之室，以突隙之烟焚。”

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

usage.en: Warning against neglecting small problems.
usage.zh: 警告不要忽视小隐患。

text: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
pinyin: yě huǒ shāo bù jìn, chūn fēng chuī yòu shēng
literal: wild · fire · burn · not · finish, spring · wind · blow · again · grow

meaning.en: Wildfire cannot burn the grass out; it grows again in the spring breeze. Vital forces cannot be destroyed.
meaning.zh: 野火烧不尽野草，春风一吹又长出来。比喻顽强的生命力或正义的力量无法被消灭。

equivalents: you can't keep a good man down

examples.zh: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生，他们的精神是压不垮的。
examples.en: Wildfire can't burn it out, spring wind brings it back; their spirit cannot be crushed.

examples.zh: 灾后的草原野火烧不尽春风吹又生。
examples.en: On the burnt grassland, fire has not finished the grass and spring brings it back.

examples.zh: 我们的文化野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。
examples.en: Our culture is like grass that wildfire can't kill.

origin.source: 白居易《赋得古原草送别》

story.en: Bai Juyi's poem on the grass of the ancient plain: 'Wildfire cannot burn it out; it springs up again when the spring wind blows' (野火烧不尽，春风吹又生).
story.zh: 白居易《赋得古原草送别》：“离离原上草，一岁一枯荣。野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。”

usage.en: Poetic line used of resilience; often both halves quoted.
usage.zh: 常用来赞美顽强的生命力，多引完整两句。

pinyin: shì bù guān jǐ, gāo gāo guà qǐ
literal: matter · not · concern · self, high · high · hang · up
natural: if it's not my business, leave it alone

meaning.en: If a matter doesn't affect me, I'll hang it up high and ignore it.
meaning.zh: 与自己无关的事，就挂在一边不管。形容对别人的事漠不关心。

examples.zh: 他总是事不关己，高高挂起，从不愿帮忙。
examples.en: He always keeps out of what doesn't concern him and never helps.

examples.zh: 大家事不关己高高挂起，问题就没人解决。
examples.en: If everyone hangs up what doesn't affect them, nobody solves the problem.

examples.zh: 她对同事的困难总是高高挂起。
examples.en: She always ignores her colleagues' difficulties.

usage.en: Criticism of indifference; casual.
usage.zh: 批评漠不关心的态度，口语。

text: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻
pinyin: hǎi nèi cún zhī jǐ, tiān yá ruò bǐ lín
literal: within · seas · exist · soulmate, edge · of the sky · like · neighbour

meaning.en: If you have a true friend within the seas, even the ends of the earth feel like next door.
meaning.zh: 只要在世上有知心朋友，即使相隔天涯，也像近邻一样。

equivalents: true friends are never far apart

examples.zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻，我们虽然远隔重洋，但心还是相通的。
examples.en: Soulmates make the world's end like next door; though oceans apart, our hearts are close.

examples.zh: 朋友出国前，他写下了“天涯若比邻”的诗句。
examples.en: Before his friend went abroad, he wrote the line 'the ends of the earth are like next door'.

examples.zh: 网络让天涯若比邻成为现实。
examples.en: The Internet has made the ends of the earth feel like next door.

origin.source: 王勃《送杜少府之任蜀州》

story.en: Wang Bo's farewell poem to Du, posted to Shuzhou: 'So long as there are soulmates within the four seas, the ends of the earth are like neighbours' (海内存知己，天涯若比邻).
story.zh: 王勃《送杜少府之任蜀州》：“海内存知己，天涯若比邻。无为在歧路，儿女共沾巾。”

usage.en: Farewell sentiment; also used of the internet and global connection.
usage.zh: 常用于送别，也形容通信发达、距离缩短。

pinyin: bù zài qí wèi, bù móu qí zhèng
literal: not · hold · that · post, not · plan · its · affairs

meaning.en: If you do not hold the post, do not meddle in its affairs.
meaning.zh: 不担任这个职务，就不过问这个职务范围内的事。

examples.zh: 不在其位，不谋其政，这件事不归我管。
examples.en: If it's not my post, it's not my business; this is not mine to decide.

examples.zh: 他坚持不在其位不谋其政，从不干涉别人的工作。
examples.en: He holds that those without the post shouldn't interfere, and never meddles in others' work.

examples.zh: 不谋其政并不意味着不关心。
examples.en: Not taking part in its affairs does not mean not caring.

story.en: Confucius: 'If you do not hold the post, do not plan its policy' (不在其位，不谋其政).
story.zh: 《论语·泰伯》：“子曰：不在其位，不谋其政。”

usage.en: Can be neutral advice or an excuse; formal.
usage.zh: 可作处事原则，也可作推托之辞，较正式。

pinyin: huó dào lǎo, xué dào lǎo
literal: live · until · old, learn · until · old
natural: you're never too old to learn

meaning.en: Keep learning all your life.
meaning.zh: 一辈子都要学习，学无止境。

equivalents: you're never too old to learn

examples.zh: 奶奶七十岁学电脑，真是活到老，学到老。
examples.en: Grandma took up computing at seventy, truly learning as long as she lives.

examples.zh: 活到老学到老，知识永远学不完。
examples.en: Learn as long as you live; there's always more to know.

examples.zh: 爷爷常说，人要活到老，学到老。
examples.en: Grandpa often says you should keep learning to the end of your days.

usage.en: A common encouragement; casual.
usage.zh: 常用的勉励语，口语。

synonyms: 刀不磨要生锈，人不学要落后

pinyin: míng bù zhèng, yán bù shùn
literal: title · not · proper, words · not · smooth

meaning.en: If the title isn't right, one's words carry no weight.
meaning.zh: 名分不正当，说话就不合道理，办事就不顺当。

equivalents: without legitimacy, no one will listen

examples.zh: 他没有正式职务，名不正，言不顺，下属不听指挥。
examples.en: With no official post, his title is not right and his words carry no weight; subordinates ignore him.

examples.zh: 名不正言不顺，没有授权就没人当回事。
examples.en: Without proper title his words don't carry; without authorisation nobody takes it seriously.

examples.zh: 我这样做名不正，言不顺，还是请领导出面吧。
examples.en: I've no standing and my words have no authority, so please ask the leader to step in.

story.en: Confucius: 'If names are not right, speech does not accord; if speech does not accord, affairs are not accomplished' (名不正，则言不顺；言不顺，则事不成).
story.zh: 《论语·子路》：“名不正，则言不顺；言不顺，则事不成。”

usage.en: Often explains why someone lacks authority; relates to 名正言顺 (the positive form).
usage.zh: 常解释为什么缺乏权威；与“名正言顺”相对。

pinyin: fán shì yù zé lì, bù yù zé fèi
literal: every · matter · prepare · then · stand, not · prepare · then · fail
natural: fail to prepare, prepare to fail

meaning.en: Everything succeeds with preparation and fails without it.
meaning.zh: 做任何事，事先有准备就能成功，没有准备就会失败。

equivalents: failing to prepare is preparing to fail

examples.zh: 凡事预则立，不预则废，考试前一定要做好复习计划。
examples.en: Preparation makes everything stand and its lack brings failure; make a revision plan before exams.

examples.zh: 凡事预则立，我们要把准备工作做细。
examples.en: Preparation is everything, so we must work out the details.

examples.zh: 不预则废，没有计划的行动很难成功。
examples.en: Without preparation things fail; action without a plan seldom succeeds.

story.en: The Doctrine of the Mean: 'In every matter, if prepared one stands; if not prepared one fails' (凡事豫则立，不豫则废), where 豫 is the old form of 预.
story.zh: 《礼记·中庸》：“凡事豫则立，不豫则废。言前定则不跲，事前定则不困。”

usage.en: Advice about planning; formal.
usage.zh: 强调计划与准备，较正式。

pinyin: yǒu zé gǎi zhī, wú zé jiā miǎn
literal: have · then · correct · it, lack · then · add · effort
natural: correct it if so, take it as a spur if not

meaning.en: If the criticism fits, correct the fault; if not, treat it as a warning.
meaning.zh: 对别人的批评，有这样的缺点就改正，没有就当作勉励。

equivalents: if the cap fits, wear it; if not, take heed

examples.zh: 同事提的意见，我们有则改之，无则加勉。
examples.en: About the colleague's comments: if they fit, we'll fix it; if not, we'll take it as encouragement.

examples.zh: 有则改之，无则加勉，这是对待批评的正确态度。
examples.en: Correct it if you have the fault, and keep watch if not: that is the right attitude to criticism.

examples.zh: 对于网友的建议，他一直是有则改之。
examples.en: He always corrects himself if the netizens' suggestions apply.

usage.en: Describes how to respond to criticism.
usage.zh: 说明对待批评的态度。

pinyin: qián shì bù wàng, hòu shì zhī shī
literal: former · matter · not · forgotten, later · matter · 's · teacher

meaning.en: Past experience, remembered, teaches us how to act in future.
meaning.zh: 记住以前的经验教训，可以作为以后行事的借鉴。

equivalents: those who forget history are doomed to repeat it

examples.zh: 前事不忘，后事之师，我们要吸取历史教训。
examples.en: What is remembered of the past teaches the future; we must draw lessons from history.

examples.zh: 前事不忘后事之师，这次事故要认真总结。
examples.en: Past events guide future ones, so we must sum up this accident seriously.

examples.zh: 前事不忘，才能避免重蹈覆辙。
examples.en: Only by remembering the past can we avoid repeating our mistakes.

story.en: Intrigues of the Warring States: 'What is not forgotten of former affairs is the teacher of later affairs' (前事之不忘，后事之师也).
story.zh: 《战国策·赵策一》：“前事之不忘，后事之师也。”

usage.en: Common in speeches and commentary.
usage.zh: 常见于讲话和评论。

pinyin: táo lǐ bù yán, xià zì chéng xī
literal: peach · plum · not · speak, below · themselves · form · path

meaning.en: Peach and plum trees do not speak, yet a path forms beneath them: true merit attracts people without boasting.
meaning.zh: 桃树李树不说话，树下却自然被人踩出一条路。比喻真诚、品德高尚的人不必自我宣扬，自然受人敬仰。

examples.zh: 桃李不言，下自成蹊，他默默工作，赢得了大家的尊敬。
examples.en: Peach and plum say nothing yet a path forms beneath them; he worked quietly and earned everyone's respect.

examples.zh: 桃李不言，下自成蹊，真正的好老师不用宣传。
examples.en: A truly good teacher needs no advertising.

examples.zh: 好产品自有口碑，正是桃李不言下自成蹊。
examples.en: A good product earns its own reputation; the peach and plum do not speak.

story.en: Sima Qian's assessment of General Li Guang: 'The peach and plum do not speak, yet a path forms beneath them' (桃李不言，下自成蹊)—a proverb about sincerity winning people without words.
story.zh: 《史记·李将军列传》太史公曰：“谚曰：‘桃李不言，下自成蹊。’此言虽小，可以谕大也。”

usage.en: Praise for modest, sincere people.
usage.zh: 称赞谦逊真诚的人。

pinyin: qián rén zāi shù, hòu rén chéng liáng
literal: former · people · plant · trees, later · people · enjoy · shade
natural: the elders plant trees, their heirs enjoy the shade

meaning.en: Predecessors plant the trees; those who come after enjoy the shade.
meaning.zh: 前人辛勤创业，给后人留下福泽。

equivalents: reap the benefits of others' work

examples.zh: 前人栽树，后人乘凉，我们要珍惜先辈留下的成果。
examples.en: Our predecessors planted the trees and we enjoy the shade; we should cherish what they left.

examples.zh: 他愿意前人栽树，让子孙后代乘凉。
examples.en: He is willing to plant trees so his descendants may enjoy the shade.

examples.zh: 今天的幸福生活是前人栽树的结果。
examples.en: Today's good life is the fruit of those who planted trees before us.

usage.en: Used to express gratitude or a sense of legacy.
usage.zh: 表达感恩或造福后代的心愿。

pinyin: yī lái shēn shǒu, fàn lái zhāng kǒu
literal: clothes · come · stretch · hand, food · come · open · mouth

meaning.en: Clothes come, just hold out your hand; food comes, just open your mouth: to be pampered and do nothing.
meaning.zh: 衣服送来就伸手穿，饭送来就张口吃，形容生活优越而懒惰，什么都不用自己动手。

equivalents: be waited on hand and foot

examples.zh: 他从小衣来伸手，饭来张口，什么都不会做。
examples.en: He's been waited on hand and foot since childhood and can do nothing for himself.

examples.zh: 别让孩子养成衣来伸手的习惯。
examples.en: Don't let children get into the habit of having everything done for them.

examples.zh: 他衣来伸手，饭来张口，自然不知道生活的艰辛。
examples.en: Waited on hand and foot, he naturally knows nothing of life's hardships.

usage.en: Criticism of dependence and laziness; also used of pampered children.
usage.zh: 批评依赖、懒惰，常指娇生惯养的孩子。

pinyin: méi yǒu bù tòu fēng de qiáng
literal: there is · not · not · let through · wind · 's · wall

meaning.en: No wall is airtight: every secret eventually gets out.
meaning.zh: 再严密的墙也会透风，比喻秘密迟早会泄露。

examples.zh: 没有不透风的墙，他的丑事迟早会被发现。
examples.en: No wall keeps out the wind; sooner or later his scandal will come out.

examples.zh: 你以为瞒得住吗？没有不透风的墙。
examples.en: Think you can hide it? Secrets always get out.

examples.zh: 没有不透风的墙，这件事很快就传开了。
examples.en: There is no airtight wall, and word spread quickly.

usage.en: Often a warning to someone trying to conceal something.
usage.zh: 常用来警告想隐瞒的人。
